title: Mouser release manifest (latest.json, tauri-plugin-updater static format; research R6)
description: Published as the `latest.json` asset of each GitHub release and fetched via https://github.com/<owner>/mouser/releases/latest/download/latest.json. The downloading desk computer re-serves this document (with `url`s rewritten to its own LAN address) in `ReleaseAvailable`. Each `signature` is a minisign signature verified against the Mouser updater public key compiled into the app.

min_protocol.description: Mouser extension: lowest peer protocol version this release interoperates with
